description: This Java class 'MoneyHelper' provides utility methods for monetary calculations, rounding operations, and tenant-specific configuration management within the Fineract platform. It manages rounding modes and math contexts per tenant, supports initialization, updates, and cache clearing, and enforces multi-tenancy isolation.

classes.name: MoneyHelper
classes.description: Utility class for handling monetary calculations, rounding modes, and tenant-specific configurations in a multi-tenant environment.

methods.name: initializeTenantRoundingMode
methods.description: Initializes and caches the rounding mode for a specific tenant during application startup.

methods.name: getRoundingMode
methods.description: Retrieves the tenant-specific rounding mode, throws exception if not initialized.

methods.name: getMathContext
methods.description: Returns the MathContext for the current tenant, including precision and rounding mode.

methods.name: updateTenantRoundingMode
methods.description: Updates the rounding mode for a tenant, invalidating the existing MathContext cache.

methods.name: createMathContext
methods.description: Creates a MathContext with a specified RoundingMode, independent of tenant context.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears all tenant-specific caches for rounding modes and math contexts.

methods.name: clearCacheForTenant
methods.description: Clears cache entries for a specific tenant.

methods.name: getInitializedTenants
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of tenant identifiers that have been initialized.

methods.name: isTenantInitialized
methods.description: Checks if a tenant has been initialized with a rounding mode.
